server_host.description: Hostname or IP address of the primary MySQL server

auth_type.description: Authentication method: 'cookie' (user enters credentials), 'config' (stored in config), or 'http' (HTTP auth)

mysql_user.description: MySQL username for authentication when auth_type is 'config'. Recommended to use a dedicated control user.

mysql_password.description: MySQL password for mysql_user. Leave empty if not required (not recommended for production).

control_user.description: MySQL user for phpMyAdmin's internal features (pmadb, relation views, bookmarks, SQL history, etc.)

cookie_secure.description: Enable secure cookies: only send cookies over HTTPS connections

login_cookie_store.description: Cookie storage time (in seconds). 0 means store until browser close. 86400 = 1 day.

login_cookie_validity.description: Login cookie validity period in seconds. After this time, the user must re-authenticate.

default_lang.description: Default interface language (e.g., 'en', 'de', 'fr', 'es'). Must match a valid phpMyAdmin language file.

default_db.description: Optional default database to display after login

compress.description: Enable Gzip compression for data transfer between server and browser

allow_no_password.description: Allow login without a password (dangerous — disable in production)

recent_limit.description: Maximum number of recent databases/tables to remember

max_rows.description: Maximum number of rows to display per page in table browsing

upload_dir.description: Server directory for uploaded files (e.g., SQL import files). Leave empty to disable.

save_dir.description: Server directory for saved exports (e.g., SQL dumps). Leave empty to disable.

servers.description: List of additional servers (beyond the first). Each entry defines a MySQL server with connection parameters.
